product_metadata.title: Ameriwood Home Edgewood TV Console with Fireplace for TVs up to 60", Dove Gray
features: Relax with your new electric fireplace and know you can avoid all the messy cleanup maintenance that you get with a wood burning fireplace

Both safe and convenient, the AltraFlame infrared electric heater provides quiet, gentle, energy-efficient heat that is eco-friendly and emits no dangerous carbon monoxide or emissions; heats a room up to 400 sq. ft. and plugs into a standard 120V outlet
Equipped with long-lasting ultra-bright LED technology with realistic logs and flame; lighting and flame effects can be used with or without heat
The modern styled Stand can accommodate a TV up to 60” wide or 95 lbs. Each shelf will hold 20 lbs. Assembled dimensions: 24.1”H x 58”W x 17.7”D. The firebox comes pre-assembled
The Stand ships flat to your door and 2 adults are recommended to assemble and move. Its durable build is made up of laminated particleboard and MDF
description: Get warm and cozy while adding a relaxing ambiance to your family room with the Ameriwood Home Edgewood TV Stand with Fireplace for TVs up to 60" wide or 95 lbs. Made of laminated MDF and particleboard and finished in a light gray laminate, the media console provides the perfect home for all of your audio and video components.
